# Verity Field Guide

An independent, evidence-first guide for the Roblox experience Survive Verity in Area 51.

## Indexable field files

- / — live official game snapshot and guide dashboard
- /gamepasses/ — official Gamepass names and prices; editorial verdicts are separately labeled
- /updates/ — official title and update-status tracker
- /codes/ — verified code-system and active-code status

Weapons, coins, and map pages remain noindex until gameplay evidence thresholds are met.
